bag.meshes: Original S_Bag meshes and skin/bind matrices
bag.conversion: Original position, rotation and scale curves resampled at 60 Hz with cubic Hermite interpolation; original textures losslessly converted to WebP

ui.conversion: Original RectTransform hierarchy, anchors, pivots and scales. Trimmed Sprite images restored to their full m_Rect canvas using textureRectOffset, then losslessly encoded. PreserveAspect is retained. Runtime labels adapted for the browser.

highQualitySprites.sourceFormat: PC BC7, replacing mobile ASTC copies for the background and featured characters

results.conversion: Original 180x360 client portraits and original profession symbols, losslessly cached. Browser layout and light columns follow in-game screenshots; they are not the Unity result shader.

effects.conversion: Original source pixels losslessly encoded; optional alpha crops remove only wholly transparent atlas margins. Colored rarity textures retain original RGB and alpha. No generated light artwork.

audio.note: The default client interface theme is used. Custom client home themes can differ. Regular interface buttons use the original g_ui_btn_h sample; g_ui_btn_n was unavailable in the public mirror.

renderer: Three.js 0.160.1 (MIT); original meshes, bones and textures, with web lighting and glow adaptation. Unity particle shaders and every client UI transition are not reproduced pixel for pixel.

source.conversion: Original client textures and Sprite pixels losslessly converted. Cropped backgrounds remove only transparent borders. Layout and material/particle settings exported for browser adaptation.
source.campMapping: character_table teamId, then groupId, then nationId; first existing original camp logo. Covers the union of all five historical rosters.

recruitment.voiceConversion: Original performances converted WAV to MP3; no trimming, speed, pitch, or synthesized speech. Original Chinese subtitles from client charword_table.

pools.layout: All five pools use their original historical client prefab hierarchy. The four added layouts and checksum-pinned source bundles are recorded in assets/official/pools/*/prefab.json. Native entry end-state transforms, sprite canvases, masks and material colors are retained; full entry transitions and Unity particle shaders are not replayed. The selector uses official announcement banners.
